component.name: NETON
component.summary: Network security analysis toolkit with port scanning, vulnerability detection, and more
网络安全分析工具集，包含端口扫描、漏洞检测等功能

description.p: NETON is a comprehensive network security analysis toolkit. It provides port scanning, password auditing, ARP device discovery, SQL injection testing, CVE vulnerability search, domain analysis, network topology mapping, NAT type detection, virus signature matching, captcha recognition, and virtual browser integration.
NETON 是一个综合性网络安全分析工具集。 提供端口扫描、密码审计、ARP设备发现、SQL注入测试、 CVE漏洞搜索、域名分析、网络拓扑测绘、NAT类型检测、 病毒特征匹配、验证码识别和虚拟浏览器集成等功能。

ul.li: Network scanning: port scanner, ARP device discovery, topology analysis, NAT detection
Password security: brute-force testing, weak password analysis
Vulnerability detection: SQL injection testing, CVE vulnerability search
Domain analysis: DNS lookup, WHOIS query, subdomain enumeration
Visual tools: captcha recognition, virtual browser integration
Malware analysis: hash checking, signature matching

description.p: Initial NETON security-focused release with comprehensive network security toolkit.
